# Review: dec.stable-ids (human acceptance)

## Subject

`dec.stable-ids` requires every node and every cross-referenced artefact to
carry a stable dotted identifier, and moves edges and artefact frontmatter onto
identifiers rather than names or paths. This review is the human acceptance pass
over that decision as it lands on `cairn.kernel.parser`.

## Verdict

Accepted.

## Justification

1. Names are display text and change for clarity. Identifiers are references and
   must not. Separating them is the only way a rename can be safe.
2. The parser already reads identifiers out of the source text, so the decision
   describes what the module does rather than asking it to change.
3. Duplicate display names become legal, which removes a naming constraint that
   was never load-bearing.

## Reservations

Every node now carries one more authored field, and the identifier convention
needs documenting where authors will find it.
